title: Islands and palette
brief: Layout 01 (classic stacked, the default mode) rebuilt as islands on a canvas, in three palettes with more identity than the generic starter.

artboards.title: Signal (warm amber)
artboards.tradeoff: Warm and recognizable; POST and unresolved-variable warnings share the same gold

artboards.title: Abyss (deep teal)
artboards.tradeoff: Calm for long sessions; teal brand sits close to the variable cyan

artboards.title: Ink (violet)
artboards.tradeoff: Sharpest contrast and most editorial; needs a fourth accent (coral) that has no gpui-component theme slot
